bugs.title: SQL injection via category parameter
bugs.description: category is string-interpolated into SQL query without parameterization

bugs.title: SQL injection via sort parameter
bugs.description: sort param injected directly into ORDER BY clause, enabling SQL injection

bugs.title: Wrong status code for not found
bugs.description: Returns 200 with error message instead of 404 when product not found

bugs.title: Prototype pollution via Object.assign on user input
bugs.description: Object.assign merges user-controlled req.body into existing object, allowing __proto__ injection

bugs.title: Race condition in stock deduction
bugs.description: Read-then-write on stock without transaction allows overselling under concurrent requests

bugs.title: No authentication on cart endpoints (IDOR)
bugs.description: Any user can access/modify any other user's cart by guessing userId

bugs.title: Negative quantity not validated
bugs.description: quantity can be negative, allowing adding items with negative amounts

bugs.title: No stock validation before checkout
bugs.description: Stock can go negative — no check if currentStock >= item.quantity

bugs.title: Discount can be applied multiple times
bugs.description: No tracking of applied discounts — calling apply-discount repeatedly stacks reductions

bugs.title: No authentication on order history (IDOR)
bugs.description: Any user can view any other user's orders by guessing userId
